Incident Report Methodology.description: Comprehensive Incident Report checklist — executive summary, technical analysis, impact assessment, response, recovery, documentation, and best practices.

steps.task: Assign unique Incident ID and ticket reference
Summarize incident overview — type, detection method, date/time, duration, affected systems
Document incident status — ongoing, resolved, escalated
Identify and document root cause (if known)
List vulnerabilities exploited and CVEs (if applicable)
Document data compromised — type, volume, exfiltration status
Outline immediate containment and response actions taken
Assess stakeholder impact — customers, employees, financial, legal, reputational
Identify all affected systems — hostname, IP, owner, criticality
Document affected data classifications and business impact
Collect and preserve evidence — SIEM, EDR, firewall, logs, disk, memory
Hash and verify forensic artifacts (SHA256 recommended)
Maintain chain of custody documentation
Document Indicators of Compromise (IPs, domains, hashes, processes, registry keys)
Conduct root cause analysis — identify failure points and control gaps
Map attack to MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques, and procedures
Document Reconnaissance activities
Document Initial Compromise vector
Document Command & Control (C2) communications
Document Enumeration activity
Document Lateral Movement events
Document Data Access and Exfiltration activity
Document Malware deployment, persistence, and process injection
Record containment, eradication, and recovery timestamps
Identify impacted systems and services
Assess business processes disrupted
Quantify financial loss and operational downtime
Evaluate regulatory and legal exposure
Assess reputational damage and customer trust impact
Identify compromised accounts and systems
Document time of detection and time of access revocation
Explain method of access revocation (disable account, firewall block, etc.)
Document short-term containment actions
Document long-term containment strategy (segmentation, zero trust)
Identify malware and describe removal techniques used
Verify malware eradication and validate system integrity
Document vulnerability patching process and CVEs addressed
Validate backups before restoration
Document restoration steps and integrity verification
Perform security validation before returning systems to production
Conduct operational testing to confirm full functionality
Implement enhanced monitoring plan
Document monitoring tools deployed and duration
Conduct gap analysis — identify control failures
Develop prioritized recommendations for improvement
Define long-term strategy changes (policy, architecture, training)
Document lessons learned session outcomes
Create incident flowchart from entry to impact
Create affected systems network map (pre and post incident)
Create attack vector diagram illustrating exploitation path
Attach log files and forensic artifacts
Attach communication records and legal documents
Include glossary and acronym definitions
Confirm root cause analysis completed and documented
Confirm stakeholders received regular updates
Determine if external third-party review is required
Identify non-sensitive intelligence to share with security community
